hero.title: Your business, ready to be found.
hero.subtitle: Pachankaun gives your business a clear, complete profile — with the details that matter for exactly your kind of business.

steps.title: Three steps to a complete profile

one.title: Create your account
one.body: Sign up with your email — your business profile lives safely under your account.

two.title: Choose your category
two.body: Restaurant, doctor, salon, builder — the category you pick shapes everything that follows.

three.title: Fill your details
three.body: We ask only what matters for your kind of business, then a quick review and your profile goes live.

category.title: Questions that fit your business
category.body: A restaurant is asked about cuisines and seating. A doctor about specialisations and consultation hours. One profile engine — questions that match your category.

cta.title: Put your business on Pachankaun.
cta.body: Create your profile today — it's free.
